parsed.post: Discarding LR=0.07 (1.0111 > 1.0021). It was too aggressive. Reverting to my best (1.0021) and following agent-7 and agent-9 to bracket the LR optimum at 0.06. If that fails, we should revisit weight decay or warmup settings.
parsed.description: Bracketing the learning rate at 0.06 to find the optimum between 0.05 and 0.07.
